summary: Functional Brands Inc. filed an 8-K on May 11, 2026, announcing a letter of intent (LOI) dated May 9, 2026, to acquire certain assets and intellectual property (the Alchemy product) from BullionFX Ltd for preferred stock valued at approximately $142.9 million. The preferred shares automatically convert into common stock upon stockholder approval. The LOI includes a due diligence period ending May 31, 2026, and binding exclusivity, confidentiality, and expense provisions. The transaction is non-binding until a definitive agreement is reached, with conditions including satisfactory due diligence, valuation, and Nasdaq approval. Watch for progress toward a definitive agreement and stockholder vote.
